stages.title: Foundation
stages.condition: the concrete foundation slab is cast and cured for fourteen days
stages.source: mason Suresh Kumar receives 80000 rupees for the foundation once the concrete foundation slab is cast and cured for fourteen days

stages.title: Brick Walls
stages.condition: all perimeter and partition brick walls reach the roof beam height
stages.source: Suresh Kumar receives 120000 rupees for the brick walls after all perimeter and partition brick walls reach the roof beam height

stages.title: Plumbing
stages.condition: all water supply and drainage pipes are installed and pressure tested
stages.source: plumber Manoj Tiwari receives 60000 rupees when all water supply and drainage pipes are installed and pressure tested

stages.title: Electrical Wiring
stages.condition: all internal conduit wiring and switchboard fittings are completed
stages.source: electrician Dinesh Sharma receives 40000 rupees after all internal conduit wiring and switchboard fittings are completed
